name: Tidal

fastest.text: Sign in at account.tidal.com, open Subscription and select Cancel Subscription.

steps: Sign in at account.tidal.com in a web browser.
note: Pay through Google Play? Cancel in your Google Play subscriptions.

faq.q: Can I cancel at any time?
faq.a: Yes. Tidal lets you cancel a subscription or a free trial at any time.

faq.q: Tidal isn't in my Apple subscriptions. Why?
faq.a: Then Apple probably doesn't bill you. Check account.tidal.com or your Google Play subscriptions instead.
